description: Reads where a project stands, as its Home shows it: marsell_says (Marsell's latest line), last_pass (when the last planning pass ran, its tokens and what it waits for), needs_you (how many cards wait for the owner's yes, about how many minutes they take, and each with its options), this_week (the week's days and their state), numbers (the numbers that move this week, with their change) and today (what was done today, with its tokens), and ask_the_owner when a card only the owner answers waits for them (tell them where it is). Use it for a quick daily look; the whole app (every place, agent and the situation) is get_app, a card whole is card_read, the numbers in full are get_analytics.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

name: get_overview
title: Get a project's overview
